mishaun-watkins.text: Says homeless programs she managed for Santa Ana (outreach, shelter, rapid rehousing) helped cut the local homeless count: "The through-line was stability over punishment. This is proof that thoughtful, well-funded programs work."

mishaun-watkins.text: As planning commissioner, says she pushed the city to modernize outdated income limits for rent and utility assistance; priorities include "increasing access to affordable housing" while spending taxpayer dollars responsibly.
